summary: ISQ Open Infrastructure Company LLC filed a Form 8-K reporting unregistered sales of equity securities and other events. As of September 1, 2026, the Company sold various share classes to accredited and non-U.S. investors for aggregate net consideration of $23,666,381 under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and/or Regulation S. It also increased holdings in an existing portfolio company during September 2026 and set Transactional Net Asset Value per share for numerous classes as of August 31, 2026. Additionally, on September 30, 2026, the Company declared distributions on several share classes. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or going-private event is present; the filing reflects routine capital raising, portfolio adjustment, and distributions.
